description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kaduruwela, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District (25/0092)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land title for multiple parcels of land in various locations. The content includes detailed land parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details (all parcels owned by "The State"), which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category definition covering land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
